column1: # Hand-written for this pack (GPL-3.0-or-later): tricky forms, phrases and negatives (words that must not reach a wrong lemma).
# Negatives that fail when a stem constraint of the own rules is deleted (sources/mutate.py, docs/languages.md 14 step 7).
# Mixed-script words (a Latin letter among Cyrillic ones) and Russian spellings: no rule reads them.
# Rows for the constraints a deletion left untested (sources/mutate.py --suggest): readings a deletion removes, and readings it adds.
# Rows whose reasons name an own transform: they pass only while that own rule reaches the form, where a Yomitan rule
# also reaches it (docs/languages.md 12.2), so deleting the own rule's stem change or constraint fails them.
